passages.quote:
If the lost-time payment only replaces an employee’s lost earnings, you do not have to report anything to HMRC or pay tax and National Insurance.

Jury service

You do not have to pay staff while they’re doing jury service, but many employers do.

If you do not pay them, they can claim a loss of earnings allowance from the court.
